SELECT STATUS_ID_FROM as FROM_STATUS_ID, STATUS_ID, DESCRIPTION, DESCRIPTION_LANG, STATUS_TYPE_ID, TYPE_DESCRIPTION,
SEQUENCE_ID, DIRECTION_CODE, ORD from ( SELECT SVC.STATUS_ID_TO as STATUS_ID_FROM, SI.STATUS_ID, SI.DESCRIPTION, SI.DESCRIPTION_LANG, ST.STATUS_TYPE_ID, ST.DESCRIPTION as TYPE_DESCRIPTION,
SI.SEQUENCE_ID, 'B' AS DIRECTION_CODE, 1 AS ORD FROM STATUS_VALID_CHANGE SVC INNER JOIN STATUS_ITEM SI ON SI.STATUS_ID = SVC.STATUS_ID INNER JOIN STATUS_TYPE ST ON ST.STATUS_TYPE_ID = SI.STATUS_TYPE_ID INNER JOIN WORK_EFFORT_STATUS WES ON WES.STATUS_ID = SI.STATUS_ID WHERE SVC.STATUS_ID_TO = #{statusId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND WES.WORK_EFFORT_ID = #{workEffortId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY WES.STATUS_DATETIME DESC ) t1 UNION all select STATUS_ID_FROM as FROM_STATUS_ID, STATUS_ID, DESCRIPTION, DESCRIPTION_LANG, STATUS_TYPE_ID, TYPE_DESCRIPTION,
SEQUENCE_ID, DIRECTION_CODE, ORD from ( SELECT SVC.STATUS_ID as STATUS_ID_FROM, SVC.STATUS_ID_TO as STATUS_ID, SI.DESCRIPTION, SI.DESCRIPTION_LANG, ST.STATUS_TYPE_ID, ST.DESCRIPTION as TYPE_DESCRIPTION,
SI.SEQUENCE_ID, 'F' AS DIRECTION_CODE, 2 AS ORD FROM STATUS_VALID_CHANGE SVC INNER JOIN STATUS_ITEM SI ON SI.STATUS_ID = SVC.STATUS_ID_TO INNER JOIN STATUS_TYPE ST ON ST.STATUS_TYPE_ID = SI.STATUS_TYPE_ID INNER JOIN WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_STATUS WTS ON WTS.CURRENT_STATUS_ID = SVC.STATUS_ID INNER JOIN WORK_EFFORT WE ON WE.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID = WTS.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ROOT_ID WHERE SVC.STATUS_ID = #{statusId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND WE.WORK_EFFORT_ID = #{workEffortId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) t2 ORDER BY ORD, STATUS_TYPE_ID, SEQUENCE_ID;
